title: pentanema indicum
intro: Pentanema indicum, commonly known as Indian fleabane, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pentanema indicum include its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
